items.title: Japanese Asanoha Starburst Privacy Screen Vector for CNC Milling
items.description: A high-demand minimalist vector design inspired by the timeless Japanese Asanoha (hemp leaf) geometric craft. This continuous repeating starburst lattice pattern is provided in clean DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, making it perfect for Scandinavian, Japandi, and modern minimalist decors. Fully optimized for CNC milling, laser engraving, and wood routing on sliding doors, privacy fences, or backlit acrylic wall art.
